Name: Colorful Skies Furniture - AT
Author: crownpossum
Description:
Last time I tried my hand at making a farm map, this time I've decided to try my hand at making furniture textures! I went with a sky/cloud theme simply because it was the first thing that came to mind.

Currently this mod adds alternative textures for the following:[list]
[*]Double Bed
[*]Couch (2 variations: basic and cloud, for all vanilla couch types)
[*]Lamp (1 variation, for all vanilla lamp types)
[*]Rainbow Rug (for Blossom Rug)
[*]Cloud Rug (for Large Green Rug)
[*]10 Wallpapers (2 types, 5 variations each)
[/list]
I might add more furniture to this set [i]someday[/i]! Not in the immediate future, but someday.
Am also considering making some color variations. [i](Sunrise/Sunset, Stormy, Starry Skies)[/i]
